title: CYBRIK investigation evidence bundle v1
description: The response SOC receives for an investigation (roadmap W0 demo: 'SOC gửi một investigation request giả lập và nhận bundle schema-valid'; ADR-0002 'Investigation Graph/Bundle'). A manifest of digest-bound references to the investigation's cybrik.claim.v1 and cybrik.evidence.v1 entries plus its own content digest — never an inlined copy of their content — so a bundle can be replayed/verified from its `digest` alone (roadmap W2: 'Structural replay từ bundle/version/digests'). `claims` MUST be non-empty: an investigation with nothing to assert MUST still surface at least one 'abstained' claim (roadmap Week 2 'Abstention/missing-evidence output') rather than an empty, silent bundle. A runtime invariant (schema cannot express it) additionally requires data_marking to be >= the union of the markings of every referenced claim/evidence (marking non-downgrade — same TR-1 stance as the accepted W2-D inference packet). Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA) by explicit Founder Option A and G-W0I01-1..5=yes on 2026-07-26.

investigation_id.description: Parent cybrik.investigation.v1.investigation_id. Required — a bundle is always investigation-scoped (ADR-0006 E6).

status.description: Snapshot of the parent investigation's status at bundle-generation time.

claims.description: Digest-bound references to this investigation's cybrik.claim.v1 entries. MUST be non-empty — an investigation with no grounded findings still yields at least one 'abstained' claim, never a silent empty bundle.

evidence.description: Digest-bound references to this investigation's cybrik.evidence.v1 entries.

limitations.description: Free-text scope/coverage gaps for this bundle (evidence-first triage instead of summary prose — roadmap Week 2).

generated_by.description: Authenticated actor (typically a service) that generated the bundle. Written only by authenticated service code.

data_marking.description: Authoritative marking of the bundle. MUST be >= the union of the markings of every referenced claim/evidence (control-enforced non-downgrade).

digest.description: Content digest of this bundle's own (claims, evidence, status, generated_at) tuple, enabling structural replay/integrity verification (roadmap W2).
